face_prompt:
Using the young man's FACE in the attached full-body PS1 character reference as the likeness AND art-style target, paint a production-ready flat frontal face diffuse for his 3D model. This is a single neutral face texture, not a rendered character and not an expression sheet.

Match the reference character's face closely: youthful, slim defined facial proportions, strong dark near-straight eyebrows, almond hazel-brown eyes with clearly readable pupils/eyelids, straight slim nose, thin dark moustache, little chin goatee with a tiny patch under the lip, sparse short jaw stubble, warm light olive-beige skin with a FEW subtle pink blemishes like the reference. Relaxed neutral closed mouth and direct forward gaze. Keep the facial features readable and handsome like the supplied reference. No heavy beard, no old tired face, no exaggerated angry frown.

Style: semi-realistic painted diffuse of a late-1990s PS1 Silent Hill human character. Moderate low-resolution detail like the face IN THIS REFERENCE, not a cartoon, not coarse 32/64-pixel sprite art, not a modern glossy HD portrait. Work visually as an approximately 128x128 pixel game face map, with restrained pixel texture, natural broad painted shading, limited desaturated skin tones, clean recognizable eyes, nose and lips. No huge square pixels obscuring the eyes; no blur, no watercolor, no crunchy giant dithering. Mild baked diffuse shades, no directional dramatic light, no specular shine. Model has an actual nose so paint nose shadows lightly.

Texture layout is critical: full square filled with skin colors, NO oval mask or face silhouette; no background, borders, seams, neck, ears, cap, head hair, clothing, backpack, straps, labels or guides. Face perfectly frontal, upright, nearly symmetrical. Plain skin reaches every edge, including top and bottom, to wrap on the whole face. All dark features stay away from the outermost 8%.
Feature locations in full-canvas percentages: eye pupil centers (30%,28%) and (70%,28%); eye width about 20%; eyebrow centers y=17%; nose tip y=50%; nostrils y=54%; thin moustache y=64%; closed mouth center (50%,70%) with width 34%; sparse chin goatee center (50%,87%) tapering and ending before y=95%. Top 10% is clean forehead skin without hair. Produce ONLY the square flat diffuse texture, designed to give the applied model the face shown in the provided character reference.
hair_prompt:
Make ONE flat diffuse texture for a small strip of SHORT DARK HAIR FRINGE to put on the forehead of a PS1 game character wearing a backward black cap. Use the natural dark tousled forehead hair of the young man in the foggy full-body character reference as the target. The separate 3D close-up reference has a bad row of uniform triangular spikes; do not copy those spikes.

Output a wide horizontal hair fringe texture on a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, approximately 4:1 aspect ratio, designed for a curved little 3D hair card. Hair runs downwards from the TOP edge. The top 35% forms a continuous dense dark-brown/near-black band all the way from left to right. The bottom 65% has a SHORT, irregular, mostly soft-looking chopped hairline made of small uneven locks, little overlaps and a few fine stray pieces, varying subtly in length and direction. No long strands, no seven evenly spaced teeth, no tall sharp V-shaped triangles, no cartoon/anime spiky haircut, no comb-shaped silhouette. Use irregular overlapping short clumps like real messy short hair flattened by a cap.

This is a semi-realistic painted late-1990s PS1 diffuse, matching Silent Hill 1. An apparent 128x32 texture enlarged with nearest-neighbor; dark brown-black palette, subtle 2–4 texel dark highlights showing strand direction, restrained texture grain. No smooth glossy modern hair, no 3D render. The hair should remain a small unobtrusive textured fringe rather than a big sculpted hairstyle.

Canvas contains ONLY the dark fringe strip, with ALPHA outside the hair silhouette and below the short irregular lower edge. No skin, forehead, eyebrows, eyes, face, cap, scalp dome, ears, background, shadows, checkerboard pattern, text or other objects. Side edges of the dense band meet the canvas sides. Top meets the top edge. Keep the strand colors near-black/dark brown so the upper band will blend into an existing dark backward cap.
reference: User-provided full-body PS1 character, explicitly excluding backpack; previous selfies used for face fitting.
